$comment: Source of truth for the photograph gallery. Read by scripts/build-gallery.mjs, which crops and compresses each source into public/gallery/, and by src/components/gallery-plates.ts, which renders them in this order. Captions and alt text live in src/app/i18n.ts under gallery.items, keyed by id. The plate marked lead is rendered full width; the rest form the grid. Newest first. /about shows only the lead photo; `feature` can add previews without removing anything from /gallery's full archive.

omitted.reason: A close selfie whose foreground face is distorted by the lens. Usable if the club wants it: recrop tighter and the distortion drops out of frame. Left out because nobody has confirmed the people in it are comfortable being on the site.

Stored rotated, and it was originally held back for that reason. That reason was wrong: the build calls .rotate(), which honours EXIF orientation before reading pixels, and a 4:3 crop of the corrected image is fine. What is left is the same question as the other seventeen: confirm these three are happy to be on the site. To publish, add a plate with this source, add its copy under gallery.items in both locales, and re-run the build.
